name: Dead as Disco

links.name: DiscoMaps
links.about: Community beatmaps, leaderboards and tournaments. Download maps there with your DiscoMaps account, then import them here.

quirks: Pak mods (characters, arenas) go to Pagoda/Content/Paks/~mods; UE4SS script mods need UE4SS, installed with the first one.
Custom beatmaps live in the Proton prefix under AppData/Local/Pagoda/Saved/ImportedSongs, one folder per map with Audio.ogg and Meta.json.
DiscoMapsLB (on Nexus Mods) adds DiscoMaps leaderboards in the game. The demo and the full game are both supported.
